Ireland
Consular help:Consular help will be provided by the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in London, United Kingdom.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens
Regular passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport NO, in the case of travel as part of an official delegation led by a minister in the Council of Ministers of BH
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina may travel to Ireland without having to obtain an Ireland visa if they are in possession of the appropriate type of United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland visa, up to 90 days, or within the validity of issued UK visa. Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina who are in possession of a transit visa, student visa or a visa issued on the basis of family connections or stay on the basis of the spouse is not allowed to enter without previously acquired Irish visa. Obligation to obtain Irish visa remains for Bosnia and Herzegovina citizens in case of a direct trip to Ireland, and not through the UK.
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina, holders of diplomatic and service passports may travel to Ireland without an Ireland visa if they are posted to the UK and hold the appropriate "exempt vignette" from the UK authorities prior to travel.For further information to the citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina who have entered the UK on foot of a UK "C" general visa and do not hold a diplomatic or special passport please refer to:
http://www.inis.gov.ie/en/INIS/Pages/Irish+Short+Stay+Visa+Waiver+Programme
Citizens of the Ireland are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina and may stay up to 90 (ninety) days in any 180 (one-hundred-and-eighty) day period which entails considering the 180 (one-hundred-and-eighty) day period preceding each day of stay.
Security Conditions: We have no information indicating any travel delays.Dialing Code: +353
